title: Unreleased photo of massive triangle over water
summary: Bob Maguire tells of Unreleased photo of massive triangle over water, about after Maguire joined the Hume Center at above water (unspecified), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they're they're there the one is a massive triangle above the water I mean this thing is huge

plain: Bob Maguire, a former contractor for the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, says that after joining a university research group he saw photos that have never been released. One, he says, shows a massive triangle-shaped object above the water, and he stresses that the thing is huge. If true, it would mean clear images of such craft exist but are being kept from the public.
